class="g-pt-50"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><div class='g-mt-30 g-mt-0--lg main-image g-brd-around g-brd-gray-light-v4 g-pa-2 g-mb-25'><img class='img-fluid' alt='' src='/site/assets/files/1255/117112801_3234148716624616_8403076109590190474_o-1.1140x450.jpg'></div><div class="u-heading-v2-1--bottom g-mt-30 g-mt-0--lg g-mb-30"><h1 class="u-heading-v2__title g-mb-10">Kite and Lift Service</h1></div><div class='details g-mb-50'><ul class="list-unstyled info-v5-3__info-list g-font-weight-700 g-font-size-12 g-color-black mb-0"><li class="g-color-white--parent-hover g-mb-20"><i class="g-color-primary g-color-white--parent-hover g-mr-10 fa fa-2x fa-euro"></i>
From € 90 € <li class="g-color-white--parent-hover g-mb-20"><i class="g-color-primary g-color-white--parent-hover g-mr-10 fa fa-2x fa-calendar"></i>
Minimum duration: 1 hour <li class="g-color-white--parent-hover"><i class="g-color-primary g-color-white--parent-hover g-mr-10 fa fa-2x fa-certificate"></i>
Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced </ul></div><div class="course-owner g-mt-25"><h4>In collaboration with</h5><img class="img-fluid gardakite" alt="gardakite" src="/site/templates/img/logo-garda-kite.png"></div><h2>BEGINNER COURSES</h2><h3><em>Try-Out Course</em></h3><p>The <strong>Try-Out</strong> kitesurfing course takes place in one session and allows you to learn the fundamentals of <strong>Kitesurfing</strong> and decide whether to continue with the <strong>Beginner</strong> or <strong>Complete</strong> course.<br>During this experience on Lake Garda, you'll enjoy controlling the power of your kite and being towed safely across the lake by your instructor.<p>As with all kitesurfing courses, even though you'll be part of a small group, you'll still receive individual guidance from your instructor.<p>Duration: The Kitesurfing Try-Out Course takes place in one session of approximately one hour. You will be guided by the instructor in a small group (3-4 people).<p>Price: €90 + €20 membership fee and insurance<hr><h3><em>Basic Course</em></h3><p>The <strong>basic kitesurfing course</strong> takes place in two sessions and allows you to learn the fundamental principles, both theoretical and practical, of <strong>beginner's kitesurfing.</strong><p>You will be placed in a group of 3 students and will be guided individually by your instructor, to <strong>learn kitesurfing</strong> in complete safety.<p>During the theoretical lessons, you will be provided with basic knowledge of kiting, meteorology, aerodynamics, and safety. Instead, during practical lessons, thanks to the use of a radio helmet, you will learn body dragging until you can try your first starts.<p>For all these reasons, this <strong>course</strong> is ideal <strong>for all beginners.</strong><p>Duration: Two group sessions that can be held over 1-2 days (not necessarily consecutive) depending on wind conditions and forecasts. Each of the two group sessions lasts approximately 3-4 hours, depending on the number of students (3-4 people).<p>Price: €280 + €20 membership and insurance<hr><h3><em>Kitesurfing Start Course</em></h3><p>The <strong>kitesurfing start course</strong> will allow you to safely learn the techniques of surfing with the board and the correct posture, thus being able to <strong>kitestart</strong> alone, completely independently and safely, respecting the rules of precedence.<p>It takes place over two days and is the natural continuation of the basic course or simply to perfect the "water start" (i.e. starting the kite in the water).<p>You will always be part of a small group, and Garda Kitesurf will provide you with individual assistance and a radio helmet, so any mistakes you make will be corrected. in real time from your instructor.<p>Duration: Two group sessions that can take place over 1-2 days (not necessarily consecutive) depending on wind conditions and forecasts. Each of the two group sessions lasts approximately 3-4 hours depending on the number of students (3-4 people).<p>Price: €280 + €20 membership fee and insurance<hr><h3><em>Complete Course</em></h3><p>The <strong>complete kitesurfing course</strong> is the longest program that includes the <strong>basic kitesurfing course</strong> and the <strong>beginner kitesurfing course</strong>. It is aimed at anyone who wants to perfect the technique learned in previous lessons before moving on to the advanced level.<p>With this course, you'll start from scratch and learn to navigate a kitesurf and your board, controlling your speed and learning to stay among other kiters while respecting the <strong>rules of precedence</strong>.<p>Duration: Four group sessions that can be held over 3-4 days (not necessarily consecutive) depending on wind conditions and forecasts. Each of the four group sessions lasts approximately 3-4 hours, depending on the number of students (3-4 people).<p>Price: €530 + €20 membership fee and insurance.<hr><h2>ADVANCED COURSES</h2><h3><em>Single Lesson</em></h3><p>The <strong>single kitesurfing lesson</strong> takes place in 1 session (morning or afternoon depending on wind conditions).<p>Suitable for both beginners and advanced kitesurfers of any level (Twintip, Surfino, or Hydrofoil).<p>However, all kitesurfing courses are part of a small group. und wirst dennoch individuell von deinem Lehrer betreut. Unabhängige Kiter können nach dem Unterricht selbstständig weiterfahren.<p>Dauer: Die Gruppensitzung dauert etwa 3-4 Stunden, je nachdem, wie viele Schüler in der Group sind (3-4 Personen). Der Unterricht dauert 1 Stunde im Wasser, danach kann der unabhängige Fahrer selbstständig weiterfahren.<p>Price: €120 + €20 for registration and registration<p>Reviewed with DeepL.com (kostenlose
